research_scope: Early/base-game Parallel Quest skills from PQ 27-30 selected after duplicate checking the canonical skill index and prior research batches.

verification_audit.method: Candidate identities were checked against the current canonical repository and prior batch names. Acquisition and core identity were then reconciled against independent Xenoverse 2 references. Unsupported drop probabilities, exact damage measurements, and version-sensitive frame data were not invented.

records.name: Heat Dome Attack
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 26 — Warrior's Annihilation - Future Chapters; Ultimate Finish reward
records.skill_description: Future Trunks surrounds himself with a large energy dome and releases a powerful Ki Blast attack.
records.mechanics_notes: Heat Dome Attack is documented as Future Trunks's Ultimate attack and as a PQ26 Ultimate Finish skill reward. Exact current damage and frame data are not promoted without a stronger current numeric source.
records.combo_notes: The attack is best treated as a committed Ultimate requiring a suitable setup rather than an unconfirmed neutral cast.
records.pve_notes: Its large blast makes it useful after reliable knockdowns or stamina breaks against AI targets.
records.pvp_notes: The high Ki commitment and Ultimate startup make a clean confirm important; exact defensive windows remain version-sensitive.

records.name: Freedom Kick
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 27 — Artificial Warriors; reward for defeating Android 17
records.skill_description: A forward-rushing kick attack associated with Android 17.
records.mechanics_notes: Independent technique references identify Freedom Kick as an Android 17 Super Skill and PQ27 references list it as a skill reward. Exact current hit count, damage, and timing are left unresolved rather than inferred.
records.combo_notes: The move is primarily a close-range Strike option and should be documented with its confirmed acquisition rather than an assumed universal combo route.
records.pve_notes: Useful as a straightforward close-range Strike Super when obtained early in the PQ progression.
records.pvp_notes: Requires spacing and confirmation because its effectiveness depends on getting the rush attack to connect.

records.name: Rolling Bullet
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 27 — Artificial Warriors; reward for defeating Android 18
records.skill_description: An Android 18 Strike Super using a forward rushing attack sequence.
records.mechanics_notes: PQ27 reward references identify Rolling Bullet as the Android 18 skill reward, while independent character/skill references identify it as an obtainable CaC skill. Exact current damage and frame behavior are unresolved.
records.combo_notes: Treat as a close-range Strike option until frame-specific combo behavior is independently documented.
records.pve_notes: Provides an additional rush-style Strike option from the early PQ pool.
records.pvp_notes: Its value depends on confirming the approach; exact punish windows should not be inferred from older references.

records.name: Super Drain
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 28 — Take Back the Dragon Balls!; Ultimate Finish reward after defeating Cell
records.skill_description: A close-range drain attack that steals stamina from the opponent and restores it to the user before knocking the target away.
records.mechanics_notes: Independent references consistently describe Super Drain as a 100-Ki Strike Super that transfers three bars of stamina from the target to the user. Exact damage and version-specific hit timing are not asserted as universal values.
records.combo_notes: Its primary value is resource conversion rather than raw damage; a confirmed close-range connection can restore substantial stamina while reducing the opponent's stamina.
records.pve_notes: Particularly useful in stamina-intensive PvE encounters because it can replenish the user's stamina while reducing the target's resource.
records.pvp_notes: The short range makes a clean confirm important, but the stamina transfer can materially change a neutral exchange when it connects.

records.name: Justice Pose
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 30 — Great Saiyaman is Here; keep Great Saiyaman 1 and 2 alive
records.skill_description: A Great Saiyaman pose skill used to activate a temporary reinforcement effect.
records.mechanics_notes: PQ30 references consistently associate Justice Pose with the hidden reward condition requiring Great Saiyaman 1 and 2 to remain alive. Exact current reinforcement magnitude and duration require further independent reconciliation and are intentionally unresolved.
records.combo_notes: This is a reinforcement/pose skill rather than a direct attack; combo claims are therefore intentionally limited.
records.pve_notes: Useful as a preparation skill when the player can safely create time to activate the pose.
records.pvp_notes: The activation commitment means it should not be treated as a free neutral option; exact defensive properties remain unresolved.
